global_help:
Usage: nscb <command> [options]

Commands:
  probe <path>
  recognize <path>
  resolve
  inspect <path>
  verify <path>
  copy <source> [destination]
  jobs <list|show|retry|clear>
  config <path|show|set|reset>
  keys set <source>

Global options:
  -h, --help       Show this help without initializing configuration.
  -V, --version    Show the NSCB version without initializing configuration.
jobs_usage:
Usage: nscb jobs <list|show|retry|clear> [options]

Commands:
  jobs list [--json]
  jobs show <id> [--json]
  jobs retry <id> [--replace] [--failed-items] [--json | --jsonl]
  jobs clear [--json]

History keeps at most 1,000 ordinary terminal Jobs. Interrupted Jobs and Jobs with unresolved artifact or publication evidence are retained for reconciliation. Clearing history never deletes outputs, configuration, keys, caches, workspaces, or other filesystem artifacts.
